summary: Four long answers of 10 marks each, all compulsory. Questions ask you to compare concepts (startup vs entrepreneurship vs business), classify (types of social enterprise) and apply a tool (a full business model canvas for a given venture). Marks reward structure, every component covered, and examples.
paper_format: MST Fall 2025: 4 questions x 10 marks, all compulsory; time in proportion to marks.
marks_structure: 10-mark application: build a complete framework (every block of the business model canvas) with figures where needed
10-mark compare/differentiate: definitions, a comparison on clear bases, examples
10-mark classify and discuss: perspectives, types, challenges and how to overcome them
repeated_topics: Product and market perspectives of entrepreneurship
Social entrepreneurship: perspectives, types of social enterprise, challenges
